This directory contains pinned local browser dependencies for reading uploaded Word templates.

- docx-preview 0.3.6 — Apache-2.0. Source: https://github.com/VolodymyrBaydalka/docxjs
- JSZip 3.10.1 — MIT or GPLv3. Used under MIT. Source: https://github.com/Stuk/jszip

The respective license files are included alongside the browser bundles. No uploaded documents are sent to these projects or a remote conversion service.
